Wahoo RGT allows you to pair your BLE and ANT+ Smart Trainer, Power Meter or Cadence & Speed sensors, and heart rate monitors to give you an immersive, realistic indoor cycling experience. 

RE-RIDE, RELIVE, RECON
Experience any route, anywhere, with Magic Roads. Upload your .GPX file from any route in the world and within minutes Wahoo RGT will build an accurate, realistic version in the virtual world that you can ride alone or with friends. Want to relive that epic bike trip? Train to grab the K/QOM on the local climb? Recon the course for your next big race or event? With Magic Roads, you can. 

REAL ROADS
The Wahoo RGT library of Real Roads allows you to choose from a selection of ultra-realistic routes, complete with authentic scenery and cheering fans. Take on the stunning Cap de Formentor or Stelvio climbs, challenge yourself on the iconic cobbled Paterberg, or take in the scenery on the picturesque gravel roads of the Italian Strade Bianche. Sort by distance or elevation to tailor your route to your goals.

REAL EVENTS
Easily create, schedule or join group rides, races, and event series. You can even add virtual riders to fill out the peloton and give you extra motivation. Customize their power output and riding style for an even more realistic racing experience.

REAL FEEL
Wahoo RGT uses an advanced physics engine to make riding in the virtual world feel like you're riding on the road. Drafting, braking, and cornering looks and feels real. This isn’t a video game, it’s a on-bike flight simulator.
